priorityList: Use Offensive Cooldowns, Racials, and Trinkets when Takedown (Black Arrow) is active or ready to be cast.
Use Potions when Takedown is ready or if the fight is nearly over.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if you are further than 6 yards from your target to continue using melee abilities.
Cast Kill Command as your top priority if you have zero stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Boomstick whenever Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Wildfire Bomb when Tip of the Spear is active, prioritizing targets with Sentinel's Mark or when you are about to cap charges.
Cast Kill Command if Takedown is about to come off cooldown and you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Takedown (Black Arrow) whenever Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Moonlight Chakram when Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Flamefang Pitch when Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Butchery) if you need to refresh the Raptor Swipe cleave buff or if Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Kill Command as a general filler to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks.
